<color=#fb9259>??-06</color>: Schorl is staying in the ward. We'll have more detailed intel once he regains consciousness.
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Roger.
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Roger!
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Heh, roger. And congratulations to everyone.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Given the remarkable success of this operation, let me summarize our findings before the supervisor returns.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: We now know that an <color=#fb9259>Abyss</color> that distorted physical laws likely formed in the center of the DisSea. The nature of this Abyss was very close to that of Mania and had been a key focus of the expedition's research.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Furthermore, we detected <color=#fb9259>another new singularity</color> in the final phase, indicating our anchored spacetime coordinates are more stable—this corresponds to the most active period of the expedition.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: According to the DisSea operation plans, EDGE's future exploration is now better outlined.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Physical condition: good. Mental state: stable. Mania influence: completely eliminated.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Welcome back, Chief. The operation was a great success, thanks to your efforts.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your emotional state has also improved significantly. Has something good happened?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Anyways, you should report to Paradeisos now. They've been waiting for a while.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Initiate the next investigation promptly! The Ring Research Institute's safety protocols have been validated. SHP-13 is secure—we can deploy him for more frequent explorations in the DisSea!
<color=#fb9259>??-06</color>: Hold on. The containment effect isn't at 100% yet. In the final five minutes, his mental contamination showed fluctuations that once exceeded the threshold. We can't take that risk.
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: That... was just because the mission site was too close to the center this time. It could also be a reasonable margin of error from the deep observation. Besides, SHP-13 himself has high uncertainty—he might have taken some atypical actions.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The Institute stated they had taken all these factors into account when they submitted the proposal.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: ...

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I agree with 06. It is good that we have identified a feasible technical solution, but we should still conduct investigations when absolutely necessary. Safeguarding SHP-13 from excessive strain should be our primary focus.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Concur. Now that things are different, he means more to us now. We must exercise greater caution.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Reviewing our safety measures before proceeding is the rational choice.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: ...Roger.
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: However, there's one crucial point to add regarding the safety protocols.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: The Institute's protocols hinge entirely on <color=#fb9259>01</color>'s calculations, relying on his tracking of previous tides and analysis of the Illusory Moon's Mania characteristics. The institute calibrated the containment system parameters solely based on the data he provided.
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: We can't rule out the possibility of discrepancies.

<color=#fb9259>??-01</color>: I agree with 07.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: It's rare to see you join the discussion.
<color=#fb9259>??-01</color>: The past discrepancies require rectification. This won't take up much of everyone's time.

<color=#fb9259>??-01</color>: Please inform everyone at the Institute that the system will be implementing corrections to the DisSea's Mania characteristics soon. I appreciate everyone's effort in adjusting the safety protocols.
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Roger.
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: ...The Institute doesn't intend to question your calculations, but this... Were there really discrepancies in your previous observations?

<color=#fb9259>??-01</color>: There's currently no evidence of issues with the observation-calculation system, though we can add some more testing procedures in the future. Nonetheless, since the shackles' characteristics remain stable, the Illusory Moon connected to them will likely maintain stability as well.
<color=#fb9259>??-01</color>: That being the case, I'm more interested in what he discovered at the <color=#fb9259>bottom of the Abyss</color>.
<color=#fb9259>??-01</color>: Well, that's all for my report. I need to get back to work.

steps.content: <color=#fb9259>??-01</color>: One last thing, please pass this message to ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I see. I've uploaded your report. This information is invaluable.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Also, I've been asked to share some good news with you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Mania Flux in the DisSea gradually settled after the Illusory Moon tide completely receded. But this time, unlike in the past, the singularity didn't vanish along with the tide.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Deep in BR-000, at the heart of the DisSea, the Mania entity that formed a connection with you remains active to this day. To put it in less technical terms...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You didn't lose anyone this time, Chief. Your companion is still waiting for you in the past.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is that so...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's wonderful, truly is...
None of it was futile. You no longer need to dread moving forward. The path ahead is no longer only about powerless loss.
Your expedition has already begun, and the path will guide you to them. This time, it will be more than just despairing farewells.
You have found the way, and you have rekindled your resolve—also your power! Everything can change now! You want to change!
And after this...

steps.speaker: Little Guide
steps.content: Hehe... Hehehe...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: What's the matter?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...No, it's nothing.
In that instant, something flashes before your eyes.
And then, even this memory sinks into the depths of the hazy dream.
